name: Nova
source:
A poor vagrant of low social status, he's a kind man who emanates an unusual charm.
While treated very badly by men, he's incredibly popular with women.
By changing his appearance, his qualities immediatly become evident. He made a noble woman fall in love at first sight.
He's also the man who will become the legendary king of pregnancy.
